summary: Corrected TASK-0014 back to the agreed Codex Python SDK route. The separate command-line Codex adapter and its tests were removed. Active docs, Skill instructions, CLI driver registry, and runnable examples now use driverRef codex-python-sdk. Prior command-line-driver evidence remains historical and is superseded by this correction.
correction_reason: The maintainer clarified that the agreed default was Codex SDK Python. Introducing a separate command-line Codex driver without approval was not acceptable.

details: Removed registration of the command-line Codex driver route.
Deleted the command-line Codex adapter implementation from the active codebase.
Kept codex-python-sdk as the only built-in non-fixture Codex driver ref.
Passed cwd into CodexConfig and thread_start so SDK sessions bind to the run-owned execution workspace.
Added SDK client coverage proving cwd reaches the SDK session.
Made CLI failure-state testing independent from whether the optional SDK package is installed locally.
Renamed branch-collision test data so it no longer references the removed route.
Changed active examples to driverRef codex-python-sdk.
Removed the separate command-line driver route from active docs and Skill guidance.
Documented that missing SDK package or account setup must fail closed and be resolved by the user.

verification_run_by_agent.command: uv run python -B -m unittest tests.test_codex_driver tests.test_cli tests.test_driver_requests tests.test_git_ops -v
uv run --extra codex python -B -c "from openai_codex import AsyncCodex, CodexConfig; import inspect; print(inspect.signature(CodexConfig)); print(inspect.signature(AsyncCodex.thread_start))"
verification_run_by_agent.notes: Confirmed the optional SDK package imports and exposes cwd on CodexConfig and thread_start.
AWKP lint passed and 56 unit tests passed.
